exports.name: InitializeTest
exports.signature: (*sanctumConcurrency) InitializeTest(ctx context.Context, payload models.ConcurrencyRequest, logger lumber.Logger) (bool, error)
exports.description:
InitializeTest : This function is called before attempting allocation of device. It performs the following actions
1. Generate Intent based on testType & isPrivateCloud
2. Use Sanctum SDK to initialize the test and lock concurrency

Success response from this function indicates that the state of test is marked
as initialized on sanctum side.

Parameters
----------
testID: testID generated by Sanctum Service
testType: type of test like app automation, web automation etc.
orgID: organization_id of the user who triggered the test
userID: user_id of the user who triggered the test
isPrivateCloud: is test is to be executed on dedicated device
logger: Global logging object

exports.name: TerminateTest
exports.signature: (*sanctumConcurrency) TerminateTest(ctx context.Context, payload models.ConcurrencyRequest, logger lumber.Logger) (bool, error)
exports.description:
TerminateTest : This function is called to release the concurrency locked for a particular test.
It performs the following actions:
1. Generate Intent based on testType & isPrivateCloud
2. Use Sanctum SDK to terminate the test and release concurrency

Success response from this function indicates that the state of test is marked
as initialized on sanctum side.

Parameters
----------
testID: testID generated by Sanctum Service
testType: type of test like app automation, web automation etc.
orgID: organization_id of the user who triggered the test
userID: user_id of the user who triggered the test
isPrivateCloud: is test is to be executed on dedicated device
enqueue: this param is used to set the state of test as queued on the sanctum side
logger: Global logging object

exports.name: ExecuteTest
exports.signature: (*sanctumConcurrency) ExecuteTest(ctx context.Context, payload models.ConcurrencyRequest, logger lumber.Logger) (bool, error)
exports.description:
ExecuteTest : This function is called after device allocation to set the state of test as Executed on sanctum side.
It performs the following actions:
1. Generate Intent based on testType & isPrivateCloud
2. Use Sanctum SDK to mark test as executed on sanctum side
Success response from this function indicates that the state of test is marked
as initialized on sanctum side.
Parameters
----------
testID: testID generated by Sanctum Service
testType: type of test like app automation, web automation etc.
orgID: organization_id of the user who triggered the test
userID: user_id of the user who triggered the test
isPrivateCloud: is test is to be executed on dedicated device
logger: Global logging object

exports.name: GenerateTest
exports.signature: (*sanctumConcurrency) GenerateTest(ctx context.Context, payload models.ConcurrencyRequest, logger lumber.Logger) (models.SanctumResponse, error)

GenerateTest : This function is called to generate testID from sanctum
1. Generate Intent based on testType & isPrivateCloud
2. Use Sanctum SDK to initialize the test and lock concurrency
